the photon statistics of amplified-spontaneous-emission light in the few-moded regime is described by a degeneracy factor that depends on the degree of coherence of the light, and that this dependence has a strong effect on the validity of asymptotic expressions that are commonly employed in the analysis of amplified-spontaneous-emission noise in optical communication systems.

the photon statistics of amplified-spontaneous-emission noise are not Poissonian and that the number of ASE modes is finite and can be estimated by the ratio between the channel and the detector optical bandwidths.

the photon statistics of amplified-spontaneous emission (ASE) in the few-mode and single-mode regimes, typical of dense wavelength division multiplexing (DWDM) transmission.
